changelog:
Initial release of mcp-skill-hardened, wrapping Exa MCP for research and search tools.

- Provides an interface to MCP at mcp.exa.ai for web search, deep research, and related capabilities.
- Includes tools: web_search_exa, web_search_advanced_exa, get_code_context_exa, deep_search_exa, crawling_exa, company_research_exa, linkedin_search_exa, deep_researcher_start, deep_researcher_check.
- Applies four security guardrails, including client-side URL validation, batching limits, anti-espionage controls, and user consent requirements for deep research.
- Outlines which tools require explicit user confirmation and which do not.
summary: Wraps the Exa MCP server (mcp.exa.ai) for web search, deep research, and related tools.
